nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Re-exports the controlled MATE vocabulary, evidence decisions, control records and planning-trace models through the domain package.

nodes.name: assessment.py
nodes.summary: Defines frozen evidence, proposal and auditor-decision records for MATE assessment. Validators enforce source classification consistency, strict approved answers and canonical UTC review times.

nodes.name: MateDimension
nodes.summary: Defines Mandate, Accountability, Trigger and Escalation, with lowercase field names and display labels.

nodes.name: ProposedAnswer
nodes.summary: Distinguishes yes, no and unresolved preparer answers before auditor approval.

nodes.name: SourceStatus
nodes.summary: Distinguishes current, superseded and uncertain source passages for assessment eligibility.

nodes.name: EvidenceAvailability
nodes.summary: Classifies reviewed support, inadequate or contradictory evidence, missing requests and unavailable or inapplicable evidence.

nodes.name: EvidenceSufficiency
nodes.summary: Separates sufficient control-design evidence from insufficient or unresolved evidence.

nodes.name: ContradictionStatus
nodes.summary: Records whether contradictions are absent, explained or unresolved.

nodes.name: AuditorDecisionStatus
nodes.summary: Restricts final auditor outcomes to approved, rejected or changes required.

nodes.name: SourceReference
nodes.summary: Stores an immutable source passage with document title, version, precise location, wording and currency status.

nodes.name: ProposedDimensionAssessment
nodes.summary: Binds one MATE dimension and proposed answer to a positive proposal version, rationale and evidence-review identifier.

nodes.name: EvidenceReviewRecord
nodes.summary: Organises immutable source references and classifications; rejects duplicate or unknown source IDs, conflicting classifications and unexplained contradictions.

nodes.name: AuditorDecision
nodes.summary: Binds an immutable reviewer decision to a proposal version and dimension; approval requires a Boolean answer and sufficient evidence, with a canonical UTC review timestamp.

nodes.name: ApprovedMATEAssessment
nodes.summary: Packages control identity, hazard, confidence, four auditor decisions and approved Boolean dimensions for evaluation.

nodes.name: enums.py
nodes.summary: Defines the three assurance ratings and eight supported WHS hazard and governance categories used by control records and API responses.

nodes.name: ControlRating
nodes.summary: Defines adequate, partially adequate and inadequate board-facing control ratings.

nodes.name: HazardCategory
nodes.summary: Enumerates supported energy, electrical, contractor, cyber-physical and governance hazard categories.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Models four strict Boolean assurance dimensions, controls with low-confidence review flags and immutable evaluation results with ordered failure names and canonical UTC timestamps.

nodes.name: AssuranceDimensions
nodes.summary: Stores the four frozen MATE checks as strict Booleans, rejecting coercion from other value types.

nodes.name: Control
nodes.summary: Combines control identity and hazard with MATE checks; adds one review-required note when confidence falls below 0.8.

nodes.name: EvaluationResult
nodes.summary: Stores an immutable rating, reasoning and UTC timestamp; validates recognised, unique failure names in canonical MATE order.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Models source-backed obligations, risks, controls, accountable roles and versioned relationships. Accepted traces require the approval-gate construction context rather than direct public construction.

nodes.name: AccountabilitySubjectType
nodes.summary: Distinguishes job-role accountability from named-person assignments so the trace gate can reject the latter.

nodes.name: TraceRelationshipType
nodes.summary: Enumerates the four allowed links connecting obligations, risks, controls, roles and approved MATE assessments.

nodes.name: BindingObligationRecord
nodes.summary: Stores the instrument, clause and wording of a binding planning requirement with its source reference.

nodes.name: RiskRecord
nodes.summary: Stores a fictional risk identity, title and risk statement with the source passage supporting it.

nodes.name: PlanningControlRecord
nodes.summary: Stores a control design statement and source reference for lineage checking against approved MATE inputs.

nodes.name: AccountableRoleRecord
nodes.summary: Records the proposed accountability subject, its role-or-person type and supporting source statement.

nodes.name: ProposedTraceRelationship
nodes.summary: Defines a versioned connection between record identifiers with rationale and nonempty, unique supporting-source IDs.

nodes.name: AuditorRelationshipDecision
nodes.summary: Stores an immutable decision for one relationship version and type, with reviewer notes and validated UTC time.

nodes.name: AcceptedPlanningTrace
nodes.summary: Aggregates approved planning facts, ordered relationships, decisions, MATE input and evaluation output; construction requires the private approval-gate sentinel.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Exposes the evaluator, MATE approval gate and accepted planning-trace builders with their blocking exceptions and trace-reference helpers.

nodes.name: approval.py
nodes.summary: Converts four source-backed proposals into approved MATE inputs only after auditor decisions, versions, evidence and answers agree. Delegates approved controls to the existing rating evaluator.

nodes.name: _one_for_dimension
nodes.summary: Selects exactly one record for a MATE dimension and raises a labelled blocking error for missing or duplicate records.

nodes.name: _index_reviews
nodes.summary: Indexes evidence reviews by review ID while rejecting duplicate identifiers before proposals are resolved.

nodes.name: _validate_unique_record_identifiers
nodes.summary: Rejects duplicate proposal ID/version pairs and reused auditor-decision IDs.

nodes.name: build_approved_assessment
nodes.summary: Requires one matching approved proposal and decision per MATE dimension, separate current-source reviews and resolved contradictions; returns ordered decisions and strict approved answers.

nodes.name: evaluate_approved_assessment
nodes.summary: Builds a Control from approved MATE fields and delegates rating to evaluate_control without changing its precedence.

nodes.name: ApprovalBlockedError
nodes.summary: Signals that otherwise valid MATE records do not meet the evidence and auditor-approval requirements for evaluation.

nodes.name: evaluator.py
nodes.summary: Rates controls deterministically: all dimensions passing is adequate; foundational or multiple failures are inadequate; one other failure is partially adequate. Records ordered failures, explanatory reasoning and actual UTC time.

nodes.name: _join_labels
nodes.summary: Joins dimension labels with commas and renders an empty collection as None for explanatory reasoning.

nodes.name: _reasoning
nodes.summary: Explains the selected rating with passed and failed labels, distinguishing foundational failure from multiple failures and a single non-foundational failure.

nodes.name: evaluate_control
nodes.summary: Applies fixed rating precedence to four MATE checks and returns an immutable result with ordered failures, readable rationale and current UTC time.

nodes.name: tracing.py
nodes.summary: Builds accepted obligation-to-rating traces after verifying current sources, job-role accountability, relationship endpoints, auditor approvals and MATE consistency. Produces stable forward and reverse references.

nodes.name: _one_for_type
nodes.summary: Selects exactly one record for a required relationship type, rejecting absent or duplicate candidates.

nodes.name: _validate_unique_identifiers
nodes.summary: Rejects repeated planning-fact IDs, source IDs, relationship ID/version pairs and decision IDs.

nodes.name: _validate_mate_assessment
nodes.summary: Checks one approved decision per MATE dimension, unique decision IDs and agreement between approved answers and stored Boolean dimensions.

nodes.name: _decision_for_relationship
nodes.summary: Finds a decision by relationship ID and version, rejecting multiple matches and falling back to type selection for precise mismatch diagnostics.

nodes.name: build_accepted_planning_trace
nodes.summary: Validates current sources, job-role accountability, exact relationship endpoints and source boundaries, matching approved decisions and coherent MATE inputs before invoking the private accepted-trace factory.

nodes.name: forward_trace_references
nodes.summary: Returns obligation-to-rating references in a fixed order, interleaving each approved relationship with its version and auditor decision identifier.

nodes.name: reverse_trace_references
nodes.summary: Returns rating, MATE, role, control, risk and obligation references in the fixed facts-only follow-up order.

nodes.name: TraceApprovalBlockedError
nodes.summary: Signals missing, inconsistent or unapproved planning relationships before an accepted trace can be constructed.

nodes.name: action_result.py
nodes.summary: Defines immutable JSON-safe action outcomes with controlled states, uppercase result codes and unique lowercase permitted-action names.

nodes.name: ActionResultState
nodes.summary: Defines OK, review, evidence, approval and blocked outcomes for workbench actions.

nodes.name: ActionResult
nodes.summary: Carries a frozen state, stable code, message and permitted actions; rejects malformed codes, duplicate actions and mutable action collections before JSON serialization.

nodes.name: relationship_review.py
nodes.summary: Applies actor permissions and request validation to fictional relationship review. Agents can draft and preview; accountable auditors can decide or revise, while storage owns transactions and idempotency.

nodes.name: RelationshipReviewActorKind
nodes.summary: Separates preparer agents from accountable auditors for final review authority.

nodes.name: RelationshipReviewActor
nodes.summary: Binds an actor identifier to its agent or accountable-auditor role.

nodes.name: RelationshipTraceInputs
nodes.summary: Packages obligation, risk, control, accountable role and approved MATE records supplied to accepted-trace construction.

nodes.name: RelationshipReviewService
nodes.summary: Validates review requests and limits final decisions and revisions to accountable auditors. Converts storage outcomes into stable action results while keeping proposal snapshots out of public state.

nodes.name: relationship_review_storage.py
nodes.summary: Persists fictional relationship review identities, immutable versions, decisions, retry records and accepted traces in SQLite. Enforces current engagement boundaries and atomically rolls back final approval when complete trace inputs are unavailable.

nodes.name: _now
nodes.summary: Returns a second-resolution canonical UTC timestamp with a Z suffix for persisted review events.

nodes.name: _json
nodes.summary: Serializes values as compact key-sorted JSON so request hashes and snapshots use consistent bytes.

nodes.name: _loads
nodes.summary: Deserializes stored JSON objects for review state, retry responses and trace input snapshots.

nodes.name: RelationshipReviewStorage
nodes.summary: Owns SQLite schema and immutable review history, proposal seeding, drafts, preview hashes, idempotent decisions and controlled revisions. Uses transactions to keep approvals, events, retries and accepted traces atomic.

tour.title: Project And Current Standing
tour.description: Start with the original fictional ACE demonstration, then use the September development record to locate the broader application. The consolidated repository contains substantial implementation, but historical completion claims do not establish current acceptance.

tour.title: Entry Point And Ratings
tour.description: The FastAPI application registers workbench and client routes and exposes fictional evaluations. Its domain records and deterministic evaluator establish the rating vocabulary that later approval workflows use.

tour.title: Evidence Before Rating
tour.description: Building on those ratings, the approval gate requires reviewed sources and accountable auditor decisions before rating proposed MATE answers. Planning traces connect obligations, risks, controls and roles through approved relationships, preserving provenance and immutable accepted records.

tour.title: Auditor Workflow And Storage
tour.description: The workbench applies these boundaries to engagement setup, capture, evidence review and relationship decisions. SQLite storage owns migrations and transactional history, while services translate controlled user actions into those stored changes.

tour.title: Controlled Client Releases
tour.description: Approved source records feed a separate release lifecycle with caller-owned transactions and immutable audit history. A pure projection prepares restricted read-only responses; the August trigger decision explains why database protections remain after service extraction.

tour.title: Traceable Document Exports
tour.description: The workbench can also package change records into spreadsheets, editable documents and checksum-bearing archives. Its toolchain probe checks document prerequisites, and the fictional Notion publisher remains an in-memory implementation rather than a live integration.

tour.title: Separate Relationship Pilot
tour.description: The Next.js application is a narrower read-only relationship-review interface alongside the Python workbench. Its Convex schema and queries provide fictional queues and linked history; this source does not establish operational parity with the workbench.

tour.title: Native Read-Only Client
tour.description: The Swift client consumes release data through controlled networking and a main-actor session state machine. Keychain handling and SwiftUI views implement credential recovery, complete-action Copy and privacy behaviour; the specification defines required evidence rather than proving acceptance.

tour.title: Tests And Native Evidence
tour.description: Python integration tests exercise review and release boundaries, while native UI tests and the Mac runner address device behaviour. Source checks, mocked runner tests and pending evidence plans have different evidential roles. Their presence in this map does not mean they ran or passed on the current checkout.

tour.title: Design History And Limits
tour.description: Read July implementation plans as intended designs, August coverage records as dated claims, and September plans as later consolidation and diagnostic context. The D2 instruction tests a hypothesis without proving the Copy finding’s root cause. The workspace guide separates retained source, historical evidence and remaining decisions.
